briefing.headline: xAI deploys Grok-3 cluster amid escalating US-China model race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases as compute scales hit new highs. Safety concerns mount while investment flows to infrastructure. Multi-agent systems drive next-phase capabilities.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with 4x reasoning gains. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3. Meta open-sources Llama 4. xAI Grok-3 hits 92% on GPQA. DeepSeek-V4 matches closed models.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. New red-teaming benchmarks show 40% bypass rates on agents. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra racks to Microsoft and xAI. TSMC opens new Arizona AI fab. Google TPU v6 pods reach 100k chips. Energy deals signed for 5GW dedicated AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the gap to frontier closed models by Q2 2027?
